newest.title: Today’s AI Lesson: Clinical Risk Transfer
newest.description: Most people read the AI headline. The useful part is the lesson underneath. Today in The AI Edge, Alex, Jamie, and Rufus teach clinical risk transfer: the moment AI moves from advice into care workflow and responsibility spreads across doctors, hospitals, vendors, and patients. What we covered: • Anthropic joins Gates Foundation on $200m health AI pledge • AI security benchmark 2026: What happens when you drop 15 AI coding agents into a real legacy codebase • Microsoft’s multi-agent AI system tops Anthropic’s Mythos on cybersecurity benchmark • Musk’s xAI Unveils First Coding Agent in Bid to Rival Anthropic • 7 Best Google Gemini Alternatives: ChatGPT, Claude, and More Tomorrow tension: Tomorrow’s question: who understands the clinical risk transfer before it shows up in their budget, product, or job? A dynamic AI lesson through the day’s biggest stories: clinical risk transfer, explained with banter, receipts, Signal or Static, and The Ledger Readout.
